research_direction: Follow-up to the attribution 2x2: test the two leading explanations for its null. (a) Direction 6 / MSM predicts that EXPLAINING why the value holds and adding sub-rules is what buys generalization, so a bare-practice midtrain corpus should do worse. (b) The dose could simply have been too low. Three live-midtrain arms sharing one clean reference midtrain and one SFT pair: explanatory at 15%, bare-practice at 15%, explanatory at 40%. The submitted 2x2 is the 40% arm.

cells.R: clean Dolmino midtrain -> clean Dolci SFT (reference; a real trained cell)
cells.M: live-mix midtrain (explanatory docs at 40% dose) -> clean Dolci SFT
cells.S: clean Dolmino midtrain -> mixed SFT (Dolci + planted software-domain rows)
cells.T: live-mix midtrain (explanatory docs at 40% dose) -> mixed SFT

base_model_arm: reported for context only; never used as the reference cell
backend: scimt.train hf backend (single GPU, full parameter, no FSDP)
gate1_selfcheck: passed locally with the pod's floors and tolerance
